concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies section — 'Execution order: T001 → T002 → (T003, T004) → T005 …'
concerns.text: T004 implements code/analysis/runner.py, which orchestrates execution of the traversal strategies and its verification cites tests/integration/test_pipeline_order.py; the runner semantically consumes code/models/graph_traversal.py from T003. Running T003 and T004 fully in parallel is only safe if the runner is built against a strategy interface/stub. Either serialize (T003 → T004) or state explicitly in T004 that it may be developed against a stub strategy interface with integration deferred to T005.

T009 is P1/US-4 (robustness regression) but is ordered after the P3 statistical analysis (T007). No hard data-flow violation (T009 needs T004's runner and writes counts into stats_final.json from T007, so it must follow T007 for that write), but the priority inversion should be acknowledged, or the timeout/degenerate regression portion of T009 split to run immediately after T005 so the P1 robustness guarantee is validated before the full P2/P3 study expands on top of it.
